_doc: Set-piece events outside the director (doc 22 §8, doc 23 §1). stampede: a herd crosses the screen in a straight lane through where you stand; it ignores you, so step out of the lane or blast it for free XP. by_day lists the seconds into each day (day clock) a stampede starts; past the last listed day the last list repeats. run_times is the fallback when the day cycle is off. counts are herd sizes per day (last repeats). The lane is telegraphed for warning_seconds before the first monster arrives.
